text:
maria: Heads up — we're seeing a hotblock fanout in eu-west1 scratchpool. IOPS spike is saturating local NVMe and GPU attaches are timing out. Several gpu-controller backoffs reported.
jamie: Can you share the error lines / sample logs? Are these only preemptible nodes? :eyes:
maria: Paste from control-plane:
```
attach_error: timeout waiting for device (i/o wait)
nvme.qos: queue_depth=1024 iops=47200
node: gn-eu-west1-123 attach_time_ms=1200
```
ankit: Confirming — k8s attach latency metric shows 2s p95 and attach backoff spikes. GPU alloc backlog rising. Dashboard: https://redwood.internal/d/ai/attach-iops?orgId=1&var-region=eu-west1
oncall-bot: Incident INC-2026-342 created and paged to oncall.
jamie: Short-term mitigation: throttle janitor/deep-scrub concurrency on affected pools, pause aggressive scrubs. That usually drops fanout load. Can someone flip the flag?
maria: Preparing a rolling change to janitor: `--max-cleaners=2 --scrub-depth=shallow` for eu-west1. Will apply to primary janitors now.
taylor: +1 from ops. Also suggest routing new GPU requests to eu-west2/dedicated if possible while we watch.
ankit: I'll adjust autoscaler/nodeSelector & put a soft-eviction rule to prefer eu-west2 for new requests.
maria: Deployed janitor cap (rolling). Initial metrics: IOPS down from 5x -> ~1.4x baseline within 90s. Attach failures decreased.
jamie: Nice. Keep the cap for now and monitor for 15m. Can we run a small fio on a canary to sanity check hotstripe health?
ankit: Running quick fio on canary node now:
```
fio --name=seqwrite --rw=write --bs=128k --size=1G --numjobs=4
```
ankit: Fio results: avg lat 1.2ms, no errors, throughput reasonable.
maria: Reopened provisioning to a small canary of 5 GPU nodes in eu-west1. Observed zero attach failures over the last 6m.
taylor: Good. Keep janitor cap until end of maintenance window (20:15 UTC). I'll create a follow-up ticket to revisit cleaner scheduling and QoS knobs.
jamie: Filed OPS ticket OPS-5678: "investigate hotblock fanout & long-term mitigations (qos, soft-throttle, smarter fanout)" https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/OPS-5678
oncall-bot: INC-2026-342 status updated: mitigated.
maria: Thanks everyone for quick actions. We'll draft a short postmortem and propose permanent fixes (per-pool QoS, adaptive cleaner backoff). :thumbsup:
jamie: Agreed — also capture cost impact (extra routing to dedicated pools) and estimate savings if we implement smarter fanout.
taylor: I'll add cost delta to the ticket.
maria: Closing thread for now; postmortem draft tomorrow morning. Thanks.
